## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the bottle with green label and white lid, shake it horizontally.

Task description: The target is the bottle lying on the right side of the table, with a green label and white cap. Pick it up and shake it horizontally back and forth in the air.

Success criteria: The target bottle is picked up and lifted clearly off the table, then shaken horizontally back and forth.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the middle of the bottle around the large orange-red label, with fingers surrounding opposite sides perpendicular to its long axis. Open slightly wider than the body there and avoid the cap and neck transition to reduce off-center gripping or rotation.
- Before closing, use a side view to confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bottle body and the pads can make effective contact, rather than merely overlapping in the image while pressing or pushing the bottle.
- The cap end is near an upright can, and a stand lies to the right. Adjust pose and shake in open space, leaving room for back-and-forth motion of cap, bottom, and gripper to reduce sweeping collisions.
- Shake horizontally with small, smoothly reversing movements, watching for the bottle to slip between the fingers. If it needs another grasp, first let the bottle rest on the table rather than releasing it while suspended.
